playstyle.identity: Varus is a poke ADC with a long-range sniper Q and spreading corruption ultimate. He excels at poking from range and can build AP for on-hit or AD for poke.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives attack speed on kills. Q charges for long-range damage. W stacks blight - popping stacks deals percent health. E is AoE slow. R fires corruption that spreads between enemies, rooting them. Poke with Q, R to start fights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Varus spikes with lethality for Q poke or on-hit for DPS. Level 6 adds engage with R. He's strong at poking and starting fights.

passive.name: Living Vengeance
passive.details: Killing a unit grants Varus bonus attack speed. Champion kills grant more attack speed.

abilities.name: Piercing Arrow
abilities.summary: Charge and fire a long-range arrow.
abilities.details: Varus charges his bow, increasing range and damage. Release to fire an arrow that damages all enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Blighted Quiver
abilities.summary: Autos apply blight; abilities detonate blight for percent health damage.
abilities.details: Passive: Auto attacks apply Blight stacks. Abilities consume Blight stacks to deal bonus percent max health damage.

abilities.name: Hail of Arrows
abilities.summary: Fire arrows at an area that slow and apply Grievous Wounds.
abilities.details: Varus fires a hail of arrows at an area, dealing damage and creating a zone that slows enemies and applies Grievous Wounds.

abilities.name: Chain of Corruption
abilities.summary: Fire corruption that roots and spreads to nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Varus fires a tendril of corruption that roots the first enemy hit. The corruption then spreads to nearby enemies, rooting them after a delay.
